name: ci-preflight-full-mode-gap
title: CI runs the review preflight only in bookkeeping mode, so a full-mode head merges unvalidated
description: The review preflight's exact-head validation runs only under the bookkeeping classifier mode, so a full-mode head never has its documentation-path, task-metadata, or journal content validated. The classifier's first gate is the event action, not the diff (tests.yml:137-139), so every pull request's INITIAL head is full and is never validated whatever it contains; validation happens only on a later synchronize push. Full mode does execute the script -- repeatedly in the unittest suite, always against synthetic fixture trees, never against the event head. Demonstrated on PR #358 (opened head passed, next synchronize head failed on the same reference) and reproduced by PR #365, whose diff was nothing but .trellis/tasks/** and whose validation step was skipped with CI Result success.
creator: sdelmas
